name: vocifly
description: Vocifly - 手机当麦克风，Mac 语音输入

scripts.build:mac: npm run fetch:mkcert && electron-builder --mac --publish never && codesign --force --deep --sign - dist/mac-arm64/Vocifly.app
scripts.dist: npm run fetch:mkcert && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never && codesign --force --deep --sign - dist/mac-arm64/Vocifly.app
